## Description

Audio split into sequence-numbered chunks, encrypted in transit, uploaded with a user-delegation SAS scoped to one session prefix; chunk manifest with SHA-256 committed via API. Interrupted transfer resumes only missing chunks (TRANSFER_INTERRUPTED). States: "Uploading 14 of 17 encrypted chunks" (review can start), "Upload failed · 3 chunks missing" with recovered range and options Retry from phone / Continue partial (missing range flagged in transcript and draft).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Killing the network mid-upload and restoring resumes without re-sending committed chunks and without duplicates (test).
- [ ] **AC2.** A SAS token cannot write outside its session prefix and expires within minutes.
- [ ] **AC3.** Integrity hash mismatch rejects a chunk and requests re-upload.
- [ ] **AC4.** Continuing with partial audio marks the missing time range in the transcript and every affected draft section.
- [ ] **AC5.** No audio is retained on the device after successful upload (cleared buffer).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
